# Gradeall

> Gradeall International manufactures waste management and recycling equipment including balers, compactors, and tyre recycling machinery for industrial operations across Northern Ireland and beyond.

Gradeall is a leading supplier of waste processing equipment based in Dungannon, Northern Ireland. The company specializes in designing and manufacturing innovative solutions for waste reduction, material recycling, and resource recovery across multiple waste streams.
